description: Export custom-domain Substack publications and post URLs, with an RSS fallback for non-Substack sites.

audienceFilter.description: Keep all posts, only free posts, or only paid posts.
audienceFilter.title: Free or paid

bodyFormat.description: Body fields to include. `none` is fastest; `all` adds HTML, plain text and Markdown.
bodyFormat.title: Post body

containsKeyword.description: (mode=publicationPosts) Keep posts whose title, teaser or text contains this keyword. Uses Substack's publication search when possible.
containsKeyword.title: Contains keyword

includeComments.description: Include public comment threads for free posts. Paid-post comments are members-only.
includeComments.title: Include comments

includePaidPreview.description: For paid posts, include the public preview body and flag it as a preview. Turn off for faster metadata-only runs.
includePaidPreview.title: Include paid post preview

includePublicationInfo.description: Add publication details such as pricing plans, sections, language and payment status.
includePublicationInfo.title: Include publication info

maxCommentsPerPost.description: Cap on comments per post, including replies. Set to 0 for no limit.
maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comments per post

maxPostsPerPublication.description: Optional per-publication cap. Set to 0 for no per-publication limit.
maxPostsPerPublication.title: Max posts per publication

mediaFilter.description: Keep all posts, audio posts, video posts, or text-only posts.
mediaFilter.title: Media

mode.description: What to scrape. substack.com-hosted inputs are reported as blocked_egress.
mode.title: Mode

postType.description: Keep all post types or a single type.
postType.title: Post type

postUrls.description: (mode=postUrls) Custom-domain post URLs, e.g. `https://www.noahpinion.blog/p/the-internet-breaks`. substack.com share links are reported as blocked_egress.
postUrls.title: Post URLs

publications.description: (mode=publicationPosts) Custom-domain publication URLs or RSS-capable sites, e.g. `https://www.slowboring.com` or `https://platformer.news`. Bare subdomains and substack.com links are blocked from this actor's cloud network.
publications.title: Publications

publishedAfter.description: Keep posts published on or after this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
publishedAfter.title: Published after

publishedBefore.description: Keep posts published on or before this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
publishedBefore.title: Published before

sortBy.description: (mode=publicationPosts) Newest first or all-time most popular first.
sortBy.title: Sort order

tagsAnyOf.description: Keep posts carrying at least one of these tags (case-insensitive).
tagsAnyOf.title: Tags

title: Substack Scraper Input
